answer_1.quote: Large Language Models (LLMs) excel at solving complex tasks such as instruction following, and multi-step problem solving.
answer_1.outputs: The outputs include transformed text based on composite tasks such as antonym-uppercase, country_capital-lowercase, and other sequential transformations, as well as responses to complex instruction-following prompts in TRACE.

answer_2.quote: We use a LLM evaluator to assign a score (from 0 to 10) for each constraint based on how well it is satisfied.

answer_3.quote: We use DeepSeek-V3 as an evaluator model, producing per-constraint scores from 0 to 10 (Prompt details can be found in Appendix B).
